blocks.x: Lou Shuby, he was the contractor for all of the bands at CBS. Of course John Hammond was the instigator. He's the one that told me about it.

Well with John Hammond, he asked me would I like to join Raymond Scott up at CBS? He approached me when I was with Cab, and the money was good, you know, and I said yes, and there was a variety of arrangements and I just wanted to change, and I wanted to be in New York too, and I took the gig. And then John Hammond was also the instigator of me leaving CBS to join Carmen Jones. Because Oscar Hammerstein and John were very dear friends, and Billy Rose.
